$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of .mcp.yaml, the one committed MCP server list. Boundary: shape only; the renderer (`pnpm agents:sync` here, `stackra mcp sync` in a project) writes the gitignored .mcp.json. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0282 (developer MCP), ADR 0196 (repository config is YAML), ADR 0173 (no secret value in a file).
title: .mcp.yaml
description: Every MCP server the project uses, in one file (ADR 0282). It is rendered into the gitignored .mcp.json that Claude Code reads. Server definitions only, never a token: a token server runs through a wrapper that injects `$NAME` values from Infisical into that one process (ADR 0173).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

mcpServers.description: Server name → definition. The name is what the assistant shows (`mcp__<name>__<tool>`).

noSecretValue.description: A literal or a `$NAME` placeholder that the wrapper expands at run time. Never a secret value (ADR 0173).

stdio.title: Local (stdio) server
stdio.description: A server started as a local process that speaks MCP over stdin and stdout.

type.description: Transport. Optional: a definition with `command` is stdio.

command.description: Executable to run. A server that needs a token runs through the vault wrapper.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the process. Values are literals or `$NAME` placeholders.

cwd.description: Working directory of the process, relative to the repository root.

remote.title: Remote (http) server
remote.description: A hosted server reached over HTTP. It signs in with OAuth on first use (/mcp).

url.description: Server endpoint. Prefer a read-only endpoint for production data.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Values are literals or `$NAME` placeholders, never a token.
